ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, many small tufts with thick stems, slightly darker green tips, firm and moist-looking, some with faint browning at tips, forming a loose cluster covering roughly 35% of the plate's left half, about 2-4 cm per floret, piled in a mound about 1.5 cm high | 190
ITEM 2 | Small whole Brussels sprouts, golden-brown to olive green with charred, slightly blistered outer leaves, four to five pieces about 2-3 cm diameter, sitting in a cluster on the right-center of the plate near the chicken | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-to-tan chunks of cooked poultry-like meat, moist with slight sheen, irregular torn pieces about 3-6 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, some with light golden browning on edges, covering roughly 20% of the right side of the plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Chopped green herb leaves and small flecks of red and green pepper mixed through a pale creamy mixture, moist and clumped, sitting among the chicken pieces on the lower right, about 5 cm across | 25
ITEM 5 | Dark green whole leaves, glossy and slightly wilted, two to three pieces about 4-5 cm long, scattered among the chicken and Brussels sprouts on the right side | 10
